verdicts.reason: Both leave the photo letterboxed with large dead white bands above and below, so neither recomposes for the new format. A puts the light-grey F logo half in the white band, where it nearly disappears against white and is cut by the photo's top edge, and sets FORCE ROGUE right across the busy windshield and hood. B sets the logo on the busy windshield too, but its headline sits bottom-left on the darker tarmac and stays readable, and its links line up with the headline's baseline, so its hierarchy is clearer than A's.
